ln:4462024169.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management.

Business:CTO Infrastructure

Principal Responsibilities

  • Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Own the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme – building and maintaining the plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID log and financials, and ensuring the workstream delivers against the commitments made into the wider programme.
  • Programme governance and reporting: Run the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream – preparing status reporting, steering and programme board submissions, and ensuring a single, accurate and timely view of progress, risk and value is available to the Group AI programme and to IDP leadership.
  • Cross-workstream integration: Act as IDP's interface into the Group AI programme, managing dependencies with other workstreams, escalating blockers, and ensuring partnership commitments, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the overall programme view.
  • Strategy development and execution: Support the Director of IDP in shaping and refreshing the function's strategy – conducting analysis, developing options and recommendations, translating agreed direction into objectives, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, and tracking delivery against them.
  • Operating rhythm and governance: Run the operating rhythm for the Director of IDP and the leadership team – setting agendas, preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and driving follow-through to closure.
  • Team effectiveness and organisational health: Support the Director of IDP on organisational and team matters, including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability planning and cultural initiatives that sustain a high-performing global team.
  • Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.

Requirements

  • Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
  • Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Strong grasp of engaging with diverse stakeholders, covering business, technology and external partnerships, to align innovation efforts with bank priorities.
  • AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services – sufficient to engage credibly with technical colleagues and strategic partners, and to translate technical progress into business terms.
  • Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are structured, governed and commercially realised within a large, regulated organisation.
  • Strategic: Proven track record in translating strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

/WX/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4457372280.descriptionHtml:
Job Objective

Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we digitalise majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.

This role will lead the design and delivery of digital channels transformation projects (IDEAL Revamp) across multiple business domains under the Institutional Banking Group, ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives. The successful candidate will combine strong banking domain expertise with deep hands-on engineering knowledge, modern software architecture experience, and proven leadership of large engineering organizations.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering delivery for corporate digital channels transformation across business domains including Payments, Trade Finance, Accounts, Entitlements, Approvals, etc.
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Lead solution architecture, technology selection, engineering standards, and development practices across the platform.
  • Establish and enforce enterprise engineering standards covering architecture, API design, microservices, event-driven systems, security, observability, testing, and release management.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, solution reviews, code reviews, design governance, and production readiness assessments.
  • Lead engineering teams in DBS Technology China and vendor partners while ensuring high-quality delivery and predictable execution.
  • Drive DevSecOps and engineering excellence initiatives including CI/CD, automated testing, performance engineering, resiliency testing, observability, and production support practices.
  • Champion adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices and development accelerators across the engineering organization.
  • Establish governance and controls for the use of AI engineering tools to ensure compliance with architecture, security, risk, and regulatory standards.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience with at least 8 years leading large-scale banking technology programmes.
  • Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale Corporate Internet Banking, Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments, Digital Banking, or Corporate Banking platforms.
  • Strong understanding of banking products and processes including:
    • Payments and Cash Management
    • Trade Finance
    • Accounts and Deposits
    • Entitlements and Access Control
    • Approval Workflows and Maker-Checker Processes
    • Customer Notifications and Alerts
    • Regulatory, Audit, and Risk Controls
  • Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise platforms using:
    • Microservices Architecture
    • Event-Driven Architecture
    • Domain Driven Design (DDD)
    • API-First Architecture
    • Cloud-Native Design Patterns
    • Micro Frontend (MFE) Architecture
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Java
    • Angular
    • Spring Boot
    • Spring Cloud
    • REST APIs
    • Kafka, AMQ, or Event Streaming Platforms
    • SQL and NoSQL Databases
    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DevSecOps
    • CI/CD
    • Application Security
    • Secure Coding Practices
    • Observability and Monitoring
    • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
    • Performance and Scalability Engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to review complex architectures, technical designs, and codebases while guiding teams toward high-quality engineering outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to engage senior business, operations, risk, and technology leaders.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software engineering tools and modern development accelerators, including:
    • Claude Code
    • Gemini CLI
    • GitHub Copilot
    • Agentic AI Development Platforms
    • AI-assisted Testing and Code Review Tools
  • Demonstrated experience establishing governance and controls for AI-generated code and AI-assisted software delivery.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and DevOps operating models.
  • Cloud, Architecture, Security, Agile, or AI Engineering certifications will be an added advantage.
Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Job ID：55775

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions for private banking CRM, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT, vendors, and cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, resolve delivery and production issues, and design technical solutions.
  • Oversee end-to-end CRM implementations, including integration with legacy and peripheral systems, data migration, and GDPR compliance.
  • Mentor and develop technical teams, establish coding standards, and drive skill development programs.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, custom connectors, and automation solutions to accelerate project delivery and ensure high-quality outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership in ALM, DevOps, and system integration, ensuring robust governance and best practices across environments.
  • Support pre-sales activities, including solution design, PoC development, and technical presentations for private banking clients.
  • Ensure cost-effective, high-quality product solutions throughout the agile development lifecycle, including backlog management, estimation, and defect resolution.
  • Provide application incident support during off-business hours and as required by project delivery.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, with at least 4 years in Power Platform architecture and implementation.
  • Proven track record in delivering large-scale private banking CRM projects, including system integration, data migration, and regulatory compliance.
  • Advanced skills in Power Apps, Dataverse, plugin development, Azure administration, and ETL processes.
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, DevOps, and reusable solution frameworks.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading teams of 30+ members.
  • Microsoft Certifications:MB-210: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales Functional Consultant; PL-600: Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect
  • Experience in private banking or financial services CRM is essential.
  • Proficiency in Power Platform environments, solutions, and governance.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., ReactJS, AngularJS, Vue.js) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including code optimization, scalability, and performance.

/WX/LP

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Tech SME Specialist.

Business: IWPB Technology

Job ID：55924

Principal Responsibilities

Technical leadership & solution design

  • Own the technical direction for key services/components, including architecture, data flows, API design, scalability, resiliency, and performance.
  • Drive engineering best practices: coding standards, testing strategy, documentation, design reviews, and maintainability.

Delivery & quality

  • Lead the team to deliver roadmap commitments on time with strong quality controls and clear risk management (dependencies, technical debt, resourcing).
  • Establish and improve CI/CD, automated testing, quality gates, and engineering metrics (e.g., DORA, defect rate, SLOs).

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Finance SMEs, Data, Platform, Security, Risk/Compliance, and Operations to ensure requirements are clear and solutions are compliant and operable.
  • Communicate technical trade-offs clearly (cost, risk, time, user impact) and influence stakeholders to align on decisions.

Production excellence

  • Improve observability (logging/metrics/tracing), capacity planning, incident response, and post-incident reviews (RCA) with measurable actions.
  • Participate in on-call/production support (if applicable) and ensure operational readiness for releases.

Coaching & team development

  • Mentor engineers through code/design reviews, pairing, knowledge sharing, and capability development.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture where different perspectives are welcomed and outcomes are delivered together.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5–8+ years in technology roles (software engineering, platform engineering, integration, or technical lead) with hands-on delivery experience.
  • Demonstrable experience working in regulated financial services (or similarly regulated environment) with strong attention to risk and controls.
  • Experience supporting production systems (on-call/incident support, problem management, RCA).

Minimum Skills Required

  • Domain & business understanding
    • Working knowledge of Wealth financial planning concepts: goals-based planning, risk profiling, suitability-adjacent processes, proposals/reports, assumptions (inflation/returns), portfolio projections.
    • Ability to translate adviser/client needs into technical requirements and solution options.
  • Technical depth (at least one strong specialism + breadth)
    • Strong engineering fundamentals: system design, debugging, performance, secure coding.
    • Experience designing and integrating systems using APIs (REST/JSON; versioning; idempotency; error handling).
    • Integration experience across enterprise environments (e.g., event messaging, file-based interfaces, batch vs real-time patterns).
    • Solid understanding of data flows and data quality controls (lineage, reconciliation, validation, reference data).
  • Architecture & non-functional requirements
    • Ability to define/assure NFRs: resilience, scalability, latency, throughput, DR, capacity planning.
    • Strong observability mindset: logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, runbooks, SLI/SLO thinking.
    • Experience with technology standards and design governance (producing/reviewing solution designs, documenting decisions).
  • Security, risk, and compliance-by-design
    • Practical security knowledge: IAM concepts, least privilege, secrets management, encryption in transit/at rest, secure API authentication/authorisation.
    • Familiarity with control expectations: audit trails, segregation of duties, change management evidence, vulnerability management.
  • Stakeholder management & ways of working
    • Ability to influence across teams: clear communication, structured decisioning, conflict-free negotiation.
    • Comfortable working with Product Owners, Architects, Cybersecurity, Operations/SRE, Data, and vendors.
    • Coaching mindset: can uplift team capability and reduce single points of failure
/WX/LP

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: HASE Technology

Job ID: 56130

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead cloud data product development: define product boundaries, data contracts, SLAs/SLOs, and consumption patterns for Finance/Risk users and downstream systems.
  • Design and build cloud data products (curated datasets/semantic layers/marts as applicable) using strong modelling practices and reusable engineering patterns.
  • Be hands-on: develop, review and maintain production-grade code using advanced SQL and Python; mentor engineers/analysts.
  • Establish strong data quality and control framework: profiling, rules, exception handling, reconciliation, and “source-to-target” validation with traceable evidence.
  • Apply cloud data architecture principles: security-by-design (IAM, encryption, secrets), non-functional requirements, observability/monitoring, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with other data teams (Business, Finance, Risk and Technology) on data governance, metadata/lineage, data standards and stewardship, and product adoption—ensuring data products are discoverable, trusted, and consistently used across the bank.
  • Support production operations: monitoring/alerting, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of reliability.

Requirements

  • Degree holder (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years’ experience delivering data projects (data engineering / data product development), including building and deploying cloud-based data pipelines and curated datasets for enterprise use.
  • Proven Technical Lead experience delivering cloud-based data products or data engineering solutions (design authority + hands-on build).
  • Strong hands-on skills: advanced SQL plus Python (basic working proficiency) for transformations, validations and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud data architecture: data modelling, integration patterns, security, scalability, resilience, and cost/performance optimisation.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and technology delivery practices (e.g., version control, code review, environment management).
  • Experience implementing data governance and controls (lineage, auditability, approvals/evidence) in a regulated environment.
  • Finance and Risk domain knowledge is required; experience delivering data solutions for Finance and/or Risk functions.
  • Fluent spoken Cantonese; strong written English for technical documentation and stakeholder communications.
  • Strong risk and control mindset; able to maintain audit-ready artefacts.
  • Cloud/data engineering/architecture certifications (Azure/AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with data observability/DQ tooling, metadata/lineage tooling
  • Exposure to regulatory programmes, data remediation, Finance/Risk reporting, or End User Computing remediation.

- Apply cloud data architecture principles: security-by-design (IAM, encryption, secrets), non-functional requirements, observability/monitoring, and operational readiness.
- Collaborate with other data teams (Business, Finance, Risk and Technology) on data governance, metadata/lineage, data standards and stewardship, and product adoption—ensuring data products are discoverable, trusted, and consistently used across the bank.
- Support production operations: monitoring/alerting, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of reliability.
Requirements
- Degree holder (or equivalent experience).
- 3+ years’ experience delivering data projects (data engineering / data product development), including building and deploying cloud-based data pipelines and curated datasets for enterprise use.
- Proven Technical Lead experience delivering cloud-based data products or data engineering solutions (design authority + hands-on build).
- Strong hands-on skills: advanced SQL plus Python (basic working proficiency) for transformations, validations and automation.
- Familiarity with cloud data architecture: data modelling, integration patterns, security, scalability, resilience, and cost/performance optimisation.
- Solid understanding of SDLC and technology delivery practices (e.g., version control, code review, environment management).
- Experience implementing data governance and controls (lineage, auditability, approvals/evidence) in a regulated environment.
- Finance and Risk domain knowledge is required; experience delivering data solutions for Finance and/or Risk functions.
- Fluent spoken Cantonese; strong written English for technical documentation and stakeholder communications.
- Strong risk and control mindset; able to maintain audit-ready artefacts.
- Cloud/data engineering/architecture certifications (Azure/AWS/GCP).
- Experience with data observability/DQ tooling, metadata/lineage tooling
- Exposure to regulatory programmes, data remediation, Finance/Risk reporting, or End User Computing remediation.
/WX/ZP

Location: Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou/Shenzhen/Chengdu/Hangzhou

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
  • Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance
  • Timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • At least 8/10 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
  • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Strong focus on client servicing
  • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
  • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems

2026RMCN

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4425099072.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Properly perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control, including but not limited to
  • contribute in the formulation or amendment of audit, risk control and accountability policies
  • participate in the internal investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of failure to perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support city CFCR team to contribute to the effective management of risks.
  • The CFCR function within the branch is the independent oversight on behalf of senior management of those core processes and related policies and procedures that seek to ensure the bank is in conformity with industry-specific laws and regulations in letter and spirit, thereby support city CFCR team helping to maintain the bank’s reputation.
  • Support city CFCR to ensure the effectiveness of the management of Compliance and Regulatory Risk issues by taking branch responsibility and leadership for compliance & Regulatory Risk. Promote, lead and manage the culture and practice of Compliance to ensure the conduct of business is within the letter and spirit of regulatory requirements and meets ethical standards.
  • Support city CFCR to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, procedures and codes by establishing and maintaining frameworks within branch in order to protect the reputation of the bank and avoid significant financial loss.
  • Support city CFCR to ensure, through the maintenance of appropriate frameworks and procedures, that material compliance and regulatory risks are anticipated, identified, escalated and reported and managed to mitigate risk, financial loss and damage to reputation.
  • Support city CFCR to provide advice to branch business & functions stakeholders on compliance relating to CFCR.
  • Support city CFCR to deliver Compliance and AML Risk Assessments.
  • Support city CFCR to respond to regulatory questions.
  • Support city CFCR to ensure the branch is properly prepared for, routine regulatory exams, audits and supervisory inspections, as well as to managing the response from related stakeholders.
  • Support city CFCR to co-ordinate with other teams in the branch (e.g. CGM office, CIB, WRB, Ops) and / or HO functions / Business segments (e.g. Finance, Product, BORM, Risk) esp. for regulatory survey and reporting.
  • Support city CFCR on the assessment of the compliance risks of proposed new products/service in the branch prior to launch.
  • Support city CFCR on active compliance supervision to ensure that the branch is aware of and observes both general and specific regulations that apply to their business activities. Support city CFCR to independently summarize, document and assess the compliance risks associated with the branch business activities, consider ways to measure compliance risks and use various compliance programmes/tools to enhance compliance risk control. Support city CFCR to assist management to identify and maintain compliance processes and procedures; identify potential compliance issues and advise on appropriate remedial action of responsible locations.
  • Assisting city CFCR on coordinating and supporting on/offsite inspections, promptly follow up any identified deficiencies, and, where necessary, formulate proposals for amendments, rectifications.
  • Support city CFCR on the delivery of compliance guidance and education programs across the branch network, based on assessment of local branch compliance quality, educating staff on branch-wide compliance issues and provide guidance to staff on the appropriate implementation of compliance laws, rules and standards.
  • Support city CFCR disseminating new and revised local regulations, policies and standards to the City network, support city CFCR to interpret them on risk-based approach, ensure appropriate coverage across businesses and co-ordination among HO and local management functions.
  • Support city CFCR to compile internal reports on a regular basis to senior management on compliance risk that has taken place within the City. Support city CFCR to coordinate various types of ad hoc reports/surveys from regulators. Support city CFCR to process local bank/product license/various local filing reports as requested. Support city CFCR to summarize any identified breaches and/or deficiencies and the corrective measures recommended to address them, and report on corrective measures already taken to regulators.
  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, properly support city CFCR to perform the duties of the leading department of fraud prevention on branch level in line with the requirements of internal policies & procedures and laws & regulations (e.g. coordinate relevant departments to implement the fraud prevention requirements forward by local regulator, collect and summarize case prevention work on branch level and coordinate with relevant departments to organize relative training etc), so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or negative reputational impact on the Bank.

Governance

  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, properly support city CFCR to perform the duties of the leading department of fraud prevention on branch level in line with the requirements of internal policies & procedures and laws & regulations (e.g. coordinate relevant departments to implement the fraud prevention requirements forward by local regulator, collect and summarize case prevention work on branch level and coordinate with relevant departments to organize relative training etc), so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or negative reputational impact on the Bank.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the City CFCR to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Strictly follow local regulators’ (such as NFRA/PBOC/SAFE) requirements of bank staff conduct.

Key stakeholders

  • CGM, business lines and support functions at branch level (e.g. CGM office, CIB, WRB, Ops) and HO functions / Business segments (e.g. Finance, Product, Risk), Director and section chief of relevant department of local regulators.

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review

Skills And Experience

  • Thorough knowledge of banking products and services, such as RMB settlement, cross-border RMB, FX under current and capital account, BOP, AML related, and the latest new polit policy for biz promotion.
  • More than 6 years work experience in banking industry, especially in Ops, TB, Compliance, or relevant regulator background
  • Sound knowledge of local regulatory requirements, local banking practices and requirements including but not limited to RMB XB and FX self-discipline mechanism, FTZ policy, credit bureau policy, individual FX policy, etc.
  • Strong local regulatory relationship management skills and have healthy relationships with key depts. of regulators, such as capital account division, current account division, BOP, AML, Financial stability, foreign bank supervisory department, etc
  • Good judgment enabling the provision of sound advice in ambiguity areas of regulation and practice and the proactive management of compliance and regulatory risk in the city
  • Deep knowledge of the process critical for implementation of risks and controls
  • Strong risk sense and the ability to assess risk in the branch

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

  • We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice. Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.
  • This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

  • Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serve more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
  • We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
  • We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
  • Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
  • Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
  • Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
  • Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

  • Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

ln:4471420237.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist .

Business: Hong Kong Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Analyse current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
  • Design and implement workflow and automation solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Define process controls, operating models, and documentation standards for automated workflows.
  • Build and support integrations between applications and services using APIs and enterprise data sources.
  • Use data and reporting to monitor process performance, identify issues, and support decision-making.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to plan, deliver, and support process transformation initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance and review design decisions across project workstreams.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of workflow design, process analysis, and automation principles.
  • Experience in Business Process Management (BPM), workflow orchestration, or similar process transformation work.
  • Ability to translate operational needs into clear technical requirements and solution designs.
  • Knowledge of Application Programming Interface (API) integrations and enterprise system connectivity.
  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including KPI tracking and trend analysis.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • Good stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to balance process improvement, delivery priorities, and governance requirements.

In This Role, You Will

  • Review and challenge of product pipelines including product design, pricing, underwriting, claims, and reinsurance arrangements.
  • Oversight the implementation Group IUR and HNW framework.
  • Strategy risk oversight including FRP review, and insurance risk perspective input on business strategy and key strategic initiatives.
  • Liquidity risk review and challenges from insurance risk perspective.
  • Facilitate GI risk control requirements and provide local inputs for model risk managements.
  • Regulatory Reporting: conduct SARMRA Insurance Risk assessment annually with review and remediation follow-up; Prepare local regulators’ required periodic and ad hoc reports.
  • Oversight the entity’s IFRS, EC, CAS25, Capital and other local regulatory reporting results.
  • Enhance and maintain insurance risk appetite framework.
  • Provide oversight and support for the effective implementation of the RMF and regulatory requirements.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Solid life insurance experience of either valuation, pricing, ALM, investment or FRM
  • Extensive knowledge of industry good practice and emerging regulations in the actuarial filed
  • Strong technical knowledge of understanding insurance financial methodologies and techniques
  • Experience of IFRS17 or CAS25 implementation
  • Commitment to quality while still meeting the deadlines
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Fast leaner and easy going to fit the team
  • Actuarial qualifications of FSA preferred
  • Good at both English and Chinese.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the engineering design and delivery of technology solutions aligned to business strategy, architecture standards, and engineering principles.
  • Own end-to-end delivery oversight, including scope, plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID management, and release readiness.
  • Drive engineering excellence across SDLC, coding standards, test strategy, automation, CI/CD, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, resilience).
  • Streamline and standardise the Investment & Managed Solutions FSA, improving governance, controls, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure solutions meet regulatory expectations, risk policies, operational resilience requirements, and audit/documentation standards.
  • Identify, prioritise, and drive adoption of AI use cases within SVS, ensuring controlled delivery, change management, and benefits realisation.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Risk/Compliance to translate requirements into deliverable, supportable engineering outcomes.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement at multiple levels, communicating engineering decisions, trade-offs, delivery status, and outcomes clearly.
  • Promote agile ways of working (SAFe) and continuous improvement across teams and delivery processes.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and performance support to engineers and junior leaders, building capability and a strong engineering culture.
  • Ensure quality deliverables are produced on time and within budget, with clear accountability for outcomes.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities to improve client experience, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Support department objectives and strategic initiatives as required.

Requirements

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken), with the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders.
  • Proven experience leading engineering delivery in complex environments with multiple teams and dependencies.
  • Strong domain knowledge in investment products, including funds, discretionary/managed portfolios, alternatives, and related services.
  • Experience working in a global set-up across time zones with distributed, multicultural teams.
  • Strong ownership mindset with clear accountability for engineering outcomes, delivery quality, and risk/control adherence.
  • Practical experience with Agile (SAFe) delivery and DevOps practices (CI/CD, automated testing, release discipline).
  • Experience with delivery and engineering tooling such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong interpersonal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with a proactive, delivery-focused approach.
  • Strong communication, presentation and influencing skills
  • Positive, proactive and can-do attitude
